description: This PHP class defines an API endpoint for performing actions (such as submit, approve, reject, pay, cancel) on claim requests within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for updating claim request states based on user actions, validation rules, and transaction management, following RESTful API conventions.

classes.name: ClaimRequestActionAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class providing functionality to perform actions on claim requests, such as submitting, approving, rejecting, paying, or cancelling, with validation, role-based access control, and transaction handling.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles the API request to perform an action on a specific claim request, updating its status accordingly within a transaction.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the API input parameters during an update request.

methods.name: getResultingState
methods.description: Determines the next state of a claim request based on the action performed, validating allowed transitions.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to fetch a single claim request.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Not implemented; intended for validation rules for fetching a single claim request.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to delete a claim request.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented; intended for validation rules for deleting.
